title: Heroin, doctors and Birdland
summary: Addiction is about accessibility; the Birdland Mafia case.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah. I heard somebody saying, 'Pardon me for saying this, but why is it musicians,' -- this was a doctor operating on my toe, 'why is it musicians are such addicts, addicted to heroin?' I said, 'Well, I know Dr. Nicemonder (PHONETIC), she's head of the Rehabilitation Methadone Program, and she explained it very simply that addiction to hard drugs is a matter of accessibility.' And I said, 'I'll tell you what she also said; that the largest number of addicts is doctors, Doctor, not musicians.'
So I said, ask one of your colleagues, Doctor, don't ask me.
That's because we're in the limelight. Nobody knows about them. It's always one of us that's shown off on something like that. And the whole group of us is tagged.

Well, you remember that time at Bird Land when they had -- that was the Mafia thing there and they had the heroin and they were getting guys hooked there to pay them off. But they got, maybe, five or six guys or something. But they were big names. So then it filtered down on everybody.
